review_candidates.title: Project Field Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a skilled and experienced  Field Engineer  to join our project execution team across Egypt . The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading site activities, supervising field teams, and ensuring that installation works are executed safely, accurately, and in accordance with approved technical and quality requirements. This role requires strong field leadership, sound technical judgment, and the ability to coordinate effectively with clients, subcontractors, and internal departments. Responsibilities: Lead and supervise the installation of steel pipelines, custom fittings, penstocks, radial gates, stop logs, and automatic cleaning weed screen systems. Manage site technicians and subcontractors, ensuring efficient workflow, workmanship, safety, and compliance with project requirements. Plan and coordinate manpower, equipment, materials, and site requirements ahead of execution to maintain project progress. Ensure installation works comply with approved drawings, welding procedures, coating specifications, QA/QC requirements, and applicable technical standards. Coordinate closely with the Technical Office, Production, Procurement, and other supporting functions to resolve site requirements and technical matters. Maintain accurate and timely daily reports covering progress, manpower, equipment, completed works, constraints, and site activities. Act as a professional point of coordination with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders throughout site execution. Identify and resolve field challenges promptly while maintaining the required standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Support inspections, measurements, handover documentation, and other project records required for completed works. Work across project sites throughout Egypt and relocate between sites according to project requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 7 years of hands-on site experience, preferably within steel fabrication, pipelines, water infrastructure, or similar industrial projects. Proven ability to lead technicians, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary field teams in demanding site environments. Strong understanding of steel installation, welding, coating, QA/QC inspections, and site documentation. Strong communication and people-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers at all levels. Strong command of Microsoft 365 applications. Excellent command of both English and Arabic. Proficiency in working with AI tools is required. What We Offer: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Opportunity to play a key role in building and developing the HR function within a growing leading steel manufacturing company in Egypt. Direct exposure to senior management and involvement in company-wide organizational development.Ongoing training and professional development opportunities. Attractive package, compensation, and benefits. A workplace where people are encouraged to grow, contribute, and take ownership. Commitment to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to succeed. Commitment to sustainable practices and responsible long-term growth. If you match the above criteria, are interested, and ready to grow with us, we would like to hear from you. Kindly send your CV to careers@elbattat.com , mentioning “Application for Field Engineer – [Your Full Name]” in the subject line.
